image_description: A retail display of comic books arranged on wooden shelves. The foreground features a wire rack filled with various comic issues, while the background shows wall-mounted shelves with more comics and promotional posters. The scene is lit by overhead fluorescent lights, creating reflections on the glossy covers.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Staple-bound periodical magazine with portrait-oriented rectangular proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple items in the foreground and background clearly exhibit the standard rectangular shape and thickness associated with staple-bound comic books.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Glossy color cover with illustrated artwork and bold title typography.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The covers show vibrant colors, illustrative styles typical of comics, and visible (though blurry) title text. Glossiness is evidenced by light reflections.
While the objects are clearly comics, the resolution is insufficient to visually confirm the tiny physical staples on the spines of the specific copies shown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Substantial page count with sequential panel layouts.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The comics are closed; interior pages and panel layouts are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Hand-drawn or digitally rendered illustrations with speech bubbles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Speech bubbles are typically inside the panels. While cover art is visible, internal speech bubbles cannot be verified without seeing open pages.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Caption boxes and dialogue text within panels.
Slightly glossy paper stock with vibrant CMYK color printing.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visual cues such as specular highlights on the covers confirm the glossy material. Colors appear vibrant and consistent with print media.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cover art exhibits dynamic character poses and action compositions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visible covers (e.g., top left poster, front rack items) depict characters in active, dynamic poses typical of the genre.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Periodical format for serialized graphic storytelling.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The arrangement in racks and the presence of multiple issues/titles confirms the periodical/retail context.

artifact_observations.location: Comic book titles and spine text throughout the image
artifact_observations.reasoning: Text on the comic covers and spines is largely illegible or morphed into pseudo-lettering. While some blurriness is expected due to depth of field/resolution, many instances show characteristic AI 'melting' of characters rather than optical blur.

artifact_observations.location: Wire rack structure in the foreground
artifact_observations.reasoning: The metal wires of the display rack show slight inconsistencies in thickness and continuity, with some intersections appearing fused or slightly soft rather than sharp and distinct.
Minor warping in the straight lines of the background shelving units and poster edges, suggesting slight geometric instability in the background generation.

selected_experts.reason: To verify that the objects are indeed classified as comic books/graphic novels and not just generic magazines or books.
To rigorously analyze the legibility and structure of the text, distinguishing between optical blur and AI-generated gibberish.
To check for boundary bleeding between the complex wire rack structure and the comics, and to ensure comic outlines are coherent.
To assess overall lighting consistency and detect any subtle global artifacts like shadow mismatches or noise patterns.

focus_areas: Legibility and structural integrity of text on comic covers
Geometric correctness of the wire display rack
Boundary separation between overlapping comic books
Consistency of perspective lines in background shelves
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's findings. If the text is completely nonsensical/gibberish rather than just blurry, this is a strong indicator of AI generation. Also, verify if the wire rack has physically impossible connections or floating segments.
